rows.label: Relative risk of neonatal death with community-based maternal and newborn care packages

source.title: Lassi ZS, Bhutta ZA. Community-based intervention packages for reducing maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality and improving neonatal outcomes. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 2015; CD007754, doi:10.1002/14651858.CD007754.pub3
source.quote: neonatal mortality (average RR 0.75; 95% CI 0.67 to 0.83; 21 studies

rows.explainer: Home visits by community health workers and women's groups in pregnancy and after birth: the Cochrane review of 26 cluster-randomised and quasi-randomised trials, random effects, net of their control arms; the confidence interval as the range. An all-cause effect, so no indirect deaths are added. How well a charity's own work fits the trials is in its evidence adjustment.
